grid: identical to heightfield.json: same dimensions, bboxCrsUnits, resolution and row order
rowOrientation: row 0 = north edge (ymax); row N-1 = south edge (ymin)

encoding.meaning: fraction of the pixel covered by tree canopy, 0 = none, 255 = full
encoding.quantisedTo: 16 levels, stored at PNG sample depth 4 and scaled x17 on decode

coverage.slopeLimit: canopy attenuated from 30 deg to zero at 45 deg, baked in

source.name: OpenStreetMap contributors
source.query: natural=wood + landuse=forest, ways and relations, out geom
source.modifications: Derived product, not the original data: polygons were reprojected to EPSG:23032, rasterised to the heightfield grid under the even-odd rule (multipolygon holes removed), and stored as per-pixel canopy coverage.
